title: What to Wear to a Holi Party in the USA and UK: Outfits and Layers
excerpt: Planning a Holi party in the USA, UK or Canada? Here is what to wear when March is still cool: easy kurtas, smart layers and practical footwear.
body:
Holi 2027 is on 22 March, and if you are celebrating in London, New Jersey or Toronto, the weather will not feel like Jaipur. The smartest Holi party outfit abroad is a light cotton kurta or tunic with a warm layer you can add or remove, plus shoes that can handle damp grass. Here is how to dress for the day without shivering or overheating.

## Why Holi abroad needs a different plan

In India, Holi arrives with warm spring sunshine. In much of the UK, Canada and the northern USA, late March can still be cool, windy or wet, and outdoor events in parks or temple grounds can feel colder than the forecast suggests. In southern US states and parts of California it may be pleasantly mild.

That means you need two things: a festive outer look in cotton, and a hidden or removable warm layer. Most Holi events abroad are also shorter and more organised than back home, often a few hours at a community hall, university lawn or temple. Dry gulal is common, and some venues limit water play, which changes what you can wear.

## Start with a cotton base

Cotton is still the best fabric to wear for Holi, even in cooler weather. It is comfortable, washes well and lets you layer underneath without feeling bulky.

A tunic over jeans is the easiest base. The [aqua leaf hand block print pintuck tunic](/products/aqua-leaf-hand-block-print-cotton-pintuck-tunic-top/) sits nicely over slim jeans and leaves enough room for a thin thermal top underneath.

If you prefer a full set, the [sage teal block print kurta palazzo set](/products/sage-teal-block-print-cotton-kurta-palazzo-set/) looks festive, and you can wear leggings or tights under the palazzos when it is cold.

## Layer like a local

Layering is where Holi abroad becomes stylish rather than awkward. A few ideas that work well:

- **Thin thermal or long-sleeve tee** under your kurta. Choose white or a neutral colour so it does not show at the neckline.
- **Denim jacket:** it looks great with a kurta, survives colour and can be washed easily.
- **Old cardigan or hoodie:** pick one you do not mind retiring after the day.
- **Light shawl or stole:** traditional, warm and easy to tie around your shoulders.
- **Tights or leggings** under palazzos or pants for extra warmth.

Avoid a good wool coat or anything dry-clean only. Colour can be hard to remove from wool and delicate fabrics.

## Outfit guide by city and setting

| Setting | Weather mood | What to wear |
|---|---|---|
| UK park or outdoor festival | Cool, possibly wet | Cotton tunic, jeans, thermal underneath, denim jacket, waterproof trainers |
| Canada community event | Often cold outdoors | Kurta set over thermals, warm socks, old hoodie, indoor-friendly layers |
| US temple grounds (Northeast) | Cool and changeable | Kurta palazzo set, leggings underneath, light shawl |
| US backyard party (South or West) | Mild to warm | Tunic with jeans or a cotton co-ord set |
| Indoor hall or university event | Warm inside | Light kurta set, layer you can remove at the door |

## Footwear and bag

Grass at outdoor events abroad is often damp, so choose closed trainers with grip. White sneakers look classic with a kurta, but keep a pair you do not mind getting stained. Avoid suede, which marks easily.

Carry a small crossbody bag with a zip, and put your phone in a resealable pouch. Pack a spare top, a small towel and a carrier bag for wet clothes, especially if you are driving home or taking the Tube.

## Colours that look good under grey skies

Soft light in the UK and Canada can make very pale outfits look washed out in photos. If white feels too stark, try a muted print instead. Sky blue is another lovely option; the [sky blue block print tunic](/products/sky-blue-hand-block-print-cotton-tunic-top/) brightens any group photo.

## Frequently asked questions

**Is it too cold to wear a kurta for Holi in the UK?**
Not if you layer. Wear a thin thermal underneath, leggings under your pants and a denim jacket or hoodie on top. Remove layers indoors.

**Should I wear white to a Holi party abroad?**
You can, and it looks great in photos. If the event is outdoors in cool weather, add a warm layer, and choose an off-white or soft print if you find bright white too harsh in grey light.

**What shoes are best for Holi in the USA or Canada?**
Closed trainers with good grip. Grass and paths can be wet, and sandals leave your feet cold and exposed to colour.
